2. End-to-End Enterprise Formal Verification, Cross-IDE DevOps Skills & Visual Documentation
Four-Pillar Workflow: Lean Studio Dual-Kernel MCP ➔ Unicode Terminal Math ➔ Kiro/Coolify Skills ➔ Jano Animated SVGs
Pillar A: Dual-Kernel Lean 4 IDE (keithadler/leanstudio)
• "Checks the Checker" Architecture: Lean 4 checks proofs
as you type, while Tenet (an independent Lean 4 kernel)
re-verifies every build from scratch
• Native Cross-Platform IDE: Runs on macOS, Windows & Linux
with Git, GitHub & an MCP server for AI assistants built in
• High-Assurance AI Coding: Prevents coding agents from
passing formal specs via environment or metaprogramming tricks
✓ Provides independent dual-kernel proof assurance via MCP
Pillar B: Kiro/Cursor/Coolify Skills (fabricioctelles/skills)
• Broad IDE Coverage: First-class support for AWS Kiro,
Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code & `skills.sh` / `agentskill.sh`
• Self-Hosted PaaS & Edge Focus: Production deployment
modules for Coolify, Cloudflare, Astro & Google Analytics
• Bilingual Documentation: English & Brazilian Portuguese
• License: Permissive Apache-2.0 License (★140 stars)
• Standardized Context: Modular context, structure & guardrails
✓ Bridges Kiro, Windsurf & Cursor with Coolify/Cloudflare ops
Pillar C: Terminal Unicode Math (agentsmith-tools/claude-math)
• Solves Terminal LaTeX Noise: Neither Claude Code nor
OpenAI Codex CLI renders raw `$...$` LaTeX in terminal output
• Clean Unicode Glyph Emission: `math-unicode` skill teaches
models to emit proper mathematical Unicode symbols inline
• Dual CLI Support: Installs as a Claude Code plugin and via
`claude-math install --codex` for OpenAI Codex CLI
• License: Permissive MIT License (★28 stars)
✓ Makes FinOps formulas, proofs & ML equations readable in CLI
Pillar D: Self-Explaining Animated READMEs (ilien-dev/jano)
• Automated Visual Storytelling: Inspects repo structure,
asks a few questions & generates a complete visual README.md
• Animated SVG Hero & Section Graphics: Draws moving SVG
diagrams at the top and above each architectural section
• Dual-Theme Brand Palette: Generates both `hero-dark.svg`
and `hero-light.svg` wired via `` media queries
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Turns plain-text repos into self-explaining visual showcases
